name: Accelerator for PU 2K
description: Solvent-free catalyst for IBTMAX 2K M (21 kg kit). Helps obtain faster drying in low-temperature situations. 1 kg per 21 kg kit.
application: Faster drying of IBTMAX 2K M in low-temperature conditions. Dose: 1 kg per 21 kg kit.
consumption_text: 1 kg per 21 kg IBTMAX 2K M kit

name: Adhes BU 1K
description: Single-component flexible PU adhesive for construction. Highly resistant and fast curing.
application: Insulation fixing, laying of synthetic flooring

name: Adhes BU 2K
description: 2K hard PU adhesive for construction. Highly resistant and fast curing. Ideal for fixing/laying R-Ston Vel carrier membrane.
application: Bonding different construction elements, insulation fixing, synthetic flooring laying

name: Antislip Additive (Coarse)
description: Coarse anti-slip aggregate (~700 microns). Excellent dispersion and finishing. Homogeneous rough mixture compliant with demanding anti-slip regulations. Can be mixed directly with IBT-Trans, CBTDUR, IBT-Tanate M.
application: Anti-slip finishes in IBT-Trans, CBTDUR, IBT-Tanate M and other finishing products

name: Antislip Additive (Fine)
description: Fine anti-slip additive for finishing products such as CBTDUR, IBT-Trans, IBT-Tanate M. For application consult technical office.
application: Anti-slip finishing in CBTDUR, IBT-Trans, IBT-Tanate M

name: B-Tecno
description: Three-component epoxy cement (2K epoxy + cement). Used as vapour barrier on moist surfaces. Apply at min. 2 kg/m². Surface repair before self-levelling products. Certified to resist 10 BAR (1,000 kPa) reverse hydrostatic pressure for 72 hours (UNI 8298 Part 8).
application: Moist surfaces/walls for better adherence of synthetic resins. Surface repair before self-levelling products.

name: Boros Sealer
description: 1K aromatic PU solvent-based. Sealing, priming and consolidating concrete. Excellent porosity sealer for completely dry concrete/cement/mortar. Can be tinted in RAL colours with pigment pastes.
application: Porosity sealer before flooring, waterproofing, or laminated fibreglass/polyester. Particle binder in anti-skid coatings for warehouses, factories, car parks.

name: Boros Sealer Flex
description: 1K PU primer for dry flexible surfaces. Cures in contact with air moisture to form a flexible coating. For surfaces subject to movement (felt, EPDM, PVC, etc.) prior to PU/polyurea systems.
application: Flexible surfaces subject to movement that need renewal with PU waterproofing systems

name: Boros Sealer Flex 100
description: 1K PU primer, very high solids, non-flammable, low odour. Forms a continuous, highly elastic coating when cured. Specifically for bituminous and/or flexible completely dry supports prior to PU/polyurea waterproofing systems.
application: Bituminous and flexible completely dry supports before elastomeric PU or polyurea waterproofing membranes

name: Epoxy Accelerator
description: Accelerates the catalysis process of Primer GC / Epoxy 100 in conditions of low temperatures and high humidity. Note: Ensure good ventilation in areas of high indoor humidity.
application: Accelerating curing of Primer GC and Epoxy 100 in low temperature/high humidity conditions

name: Geomax (80 g/m²)
description: Fiberglass reinforcement for liquid membranes. Reinforced application of liquid membranes at details and critical points. Check BUILD-TECH Chemical Waterproofing Manual for more information.
application: Reinforced application of IBTmax liquid membranes in details and critical points

name: Geotextile 200 g/m²
description: Geotextile fabric made of synthetic polyester/polyamide fibres. Supplementary reinforcement of IBTmax membranes. White, 200 g/m², high mechanical strength.
application: Supplementary reinforcement of IBTmax waterproofing membranes

name: Geotextile 350 g/m²
description: Geotextile fabric made of synthetic polyester/polyamide fibres. Heavy-duty 350 g/m². Black. For supplementary reinforcement and protection.
application: Supplementary reinforcement of IBTmax waterproofing membranes

name: Humidity Primer
description: 2K water-based epoxy formulation. Perfect for priming wet porous substrates for epoxy or PU systems. High chemical resistance. Anti-dust coating for cement flooring or walls. Allows adhesion between concrete pieces.
application: Wet concrete/mortar surfaces before epoxy/PU coatings. Anti-dust coating for cement flooring and walls.

name: Humidity Primer LV
description: 2K water-based low-viscosity epoxy formulation. High chemical resistance. Anti-dust coating for cement flooring or wall treatment. Allows adhesion between concrete pieces. Applied by roller, brush or airless spray.
application: Wet concrete/mortar. Anti-dust coating. Adhesion between concrete pieces.

name: Matting Additive
description: Reduces the surface gloss of polyurethane products without affecting mechanical properties. Pre-dosed for combining with 20 kg of clear polyurethane such as CBTDUR or IBT-Trans. Ensure correct mixing before application.
application: Reducing gloss of polyurethane coatings (CBTDUR, IBT-Trans). Pre-dosed for 20 kg.
consumption_text: Pre-dosed for 20 kg of clear PU

name: Non-Woven Fleece (150 g/m²)
description: Non-woven fleece, heavier weight. Without adhesive. EU specification.
application: Reinforcement of liquid membranes

name: Non-Woven Fleece (30 g/m²)
description: Non-woven fleece for reinforcement applications. Without adhesive.
application: Reinforcement of liquid membranes

name: Paint Stripper K
description: Concentrated gel stripper for cleaning paint residues, waterproofing, foams, etc. Great softening power. Applied with brush or roller on the surface to be treated.
application: Cleaning/stripping paint residues, waterproofing residues, foam residues from surfaces

name: Plugs for R-Ston Fiber Net
description: Polypropylene plug with fibreglass reinforced plastic nail for fixing R-Ston Fiber Net. Easy to assemble. 8mm drill, 40mm min. perforation, 77mm plug length, 70mm nail length.
application: Fixing R-Ston Fiber Net to substrates

name: Polyurea Primer
description: Fast curing, cold applied polyurea primer. Solvent based. Sealant of porous substrates (concrete, cement) before application of PU or polyurea waterproofing membranes.
application: Adhesion layer, sealant and strengthener for hard, porous and dry substrates before PU/polyurea waterproofing

name: Polyurea Primer Flex
description: Fast curing, flexible, cold applied polyurea primer. Solvent based. For flexible and dry substrates (PVC, EPDM, asphalt felts, except polyolefins) which need to be renewed with liquid-applied membranes, especially hot-applied ones.
application: Adhesion layer for flexible/dry substrates (PVC, EPDM, asphalt felts) before liquid-applied membranes

name: Primer Epoxy 100
description: 2K universal epoxy primer for completely dry surfaces. Low viscosity, high performance, solvent-free. Universal primer for polyurea and most flooring applications. Can be used for dry mortar preparation (8:1 with sand).
application: Universal primer for polyurea and flooring. Anchoring/sealing concrete surfaces. Dry mortar (8:1 with sand). Pre-levelling layer. Union between new and old mortar.

name: Primer Epoxy Plus
description: 2K universal epoxy primer for completely dry surfaces. High performance, solvent-free. For waterproofing and flooring solutions. Good for dry mortar (8:1 with sand) and as levelling layer. Dilute 5–10% with R-Ston solvent on slightly porous surfaces.
application: Dry mortar preparation (8:1 with sand). Levelling layer. Waterproofing and flooring primer.

name: Primer Epoxy Plus 2
description: Epoxy primer, 100% solids with mineral fillers. For concrete, mortar or ceramic surfaces ensuring good adhesion with R-Ston waterproofing and flooring systems. Dilute 5–10% with R-Ston solvent on slightly porous surfaces.
application: Concrete, mortar or ceramic surfaces before R-Ston waterproofing and flooring systems

name: Primer GC
description: 2K solvent-free epoxy, quick curing. Very good adhesion on high-humidity concrete/mortar without standing water. Does not provide a vapour barrier. Compatible with wet substrates.
application: Primer over wet substrates (not under negative pressure) for floor coatings and waterproofing membranes (hot spray or cold applied). Podium decks, basements.

name: Primer GC TH
description: 2K solvent-free low-viscosity epoxy, quick curing. Very good adhesion on high-humidity porous supports without standing water. Does not provide a vapour barrier.
application: Primer over wet substrates (not under negative pressure) for floor coatings and waterproofing membranes.

name: Primer PU 2K
description: Two-component, solvent-free PU primer. For polyurea and polyurethane membranes applied on dry, rigid, and porous substrates. Suitable for waterproofing with low stress requirements or when the membrane is not exposed.
application: Primer for polyureas and polyurethanes on dry, rigid, porous substrates

name: Primer PU 2K Bio
description: Two-component, solvent-free biobased PU primer. Specifically designed to seal dry, highly porous and non-cohesive supports (lightened mortars) before biobased membranes.
application: Primer for biobased membranes on dry, highly porous and non-cohesive supports

name: PU Primer
description: Adhesion promoter for difficult, non-porous, smooth dry surfaces. Does not form a film. Applied by roller, brush or spray (best when brushed). Do not apply on dirty, damp or wet supports.
application: Promotes adhesion of PU coatings and membranes on non-porous smooth surfaces (metal, glass, etc.)

name: PUR Additive (Accelerator)
description: Accelerates curing of IBTMAX and 1K PU products. Especially for vertical surfaces or steep slopes. Allow 5–10 minutes after addition and mixing before application.
application: Accelerating curing of IBTMAX on vertical surfaces or steep slopes. Dose: 1 kg per 25 kg IBTMAX.

name: R-Ston Epoxy 100 Gel
description: Transparent 2K sealer based on solvent-free epoxy. Specifically designed to seal dry porous or irregular vertical surfaces. Fast curing, excellent sealing properties, good mechanical properties and chemical resistance.
application: Sealing dry porous or very irregular vertical surfaces before R-Ston waterproofing/flooring systems

name: R-Ston Fiber (NMDC for Hot Spray)
description: Special non-woven material with NMDC treatment. Allows hot spray polyurea applications onto any existing substrate. High mechanical strength (165 g/m²).
application: Hot spray polyurea applications on existing substrates. Provides continuity and thickness consistency by embedding into first layer.

name: R-Ston Fiber Net
description: Fiberglass mesh white coloured, high-efficiency anti-alkaline protection. Used to apply epoxy/PU flooring onto awkward substrates or tiles. Ideal in combination with IBTmax and IBTmax Cold Polyurea systems.
application: Applying epoxy/PU flooring on awkward substrates or tiles. Supplementary reinforcement of IBTmax membranes.

name: R-Ston Fluid
description: Mixing of oils and plasticizers for cleaning and maintenance of hoses in spray equipment. Prevents formation of isocyanate residues in equipment.
application: Cleaning and maintenance of hoses in polyurea/polyurethane spray equipment

name: R-Ston Insulation Adhesive
description: Solvent-free foaming moisture-cured 1K PU adhesive for bonding insulation boards to decks and vapour control layers on roofs.
application: Bonding insulation boards on roofs to decks and vapour control layers

name: R-Ston Prim PU 100
description: Solvent-free, 100% solid, 1K PU primer. Applied under IBT-Stone 1K System or on concrete substrates requiring sealing/consolidation.
application: Primer under IBT-Stone 1K System. Sealing/consolidation of concrete substrates.

name: R-Ston PU Primer 1K
description: Single-pack moisture-cure fast-drying PU anticorrosion primer with zinc and MIO. Cathodic (galvanic) and barrier long-term protection. No dew point restrictions up to 99% RH.
application: Primer for waterproofing systems on steel substrates. C3–C5 & CX atmospheric corrosivity. -18°C to +55°C.

name: R-Ston PU Solvent
description: 100% compatible solvent for R-Ston products. Suitable for IBTMAX, IBT-Trans, CBTDUR, Epoxy 100, etc. Allows 2 kg/m² in one pass and wet-on-wet cycles. Note: may cause yellowing in light colours.
application: Dilution of PU products before application. Cleaning.

name: R-Ston Spray Foam 8W/30W/40W/50W
description: Bi-component PU foam system, very low environmental impact (water as foaming agent). Applied with projection machine. Densities: 8, 30, 40 or 50 kg/m³. R-Ston Spray Foam 50W can be used as adherence layer and support regulator for hot-applied polyurea.
application: Thermal and acoustic insulation. Adherence layer/support regulator for hot-applied polyurea membranes in roof waterproofing.

name: R-Ston Spray Foam HFO 35/40/50
description: 2K PU foam system with low environmental impact (HFO gas as foaming agent). Applied with projection machine. Densities: 35, 40 or 50 kg/m³. HFO 50 can be used as adherence layer and support regulator.
application: Thermal and acoustic insulation. Adherence layer/support regulator for hot-applied polyurea membranes.

name: R-Ston Spray Primer 150
description: High-density spray foam. Uniform and smooth finish with high grip. Ideal primer for irregular substrates. Do not leave exposed for more than 1 hour before applying polyurea. Allows minimum waiting time before hot spray application.
application: Primer for irregular and porous substrates (cement, concrete decks) before hot spray PU/PUA membranes.

name: R-Ston Vel
description: Fiberglass base felt covered with solid oxidised asphalt, fine sand on both sides. Carrier for IBTmax Strat System. Unique formulation prevents staining/contamination of PU membranes above. Designed for use on top of insulation boards.
application: Carrier on roofs for IBTmax Strat System. Old roofs with asphalt, hot melt bitumen or similar.

name: R-Ston Vel Plus
description: Self-adhesive multilayer membrane, watertight. Total barrier against water vapour and other gases. Low-thickness bituminous compound, self-protected by reinforced aluminium foil and fibreglass net. Used as carrier membrane in IBTmax Strat System.
application: Carrier membrane in IBTmax Strat System. Support for semi-adhered systems before liquid membrane application.

name: Slow Solvent PU
description: 100% retardant solvent compatible with R-Ston products. Suitable for IBTMAX, IBT-Trans, CBTDUR. Prolongs catalytic periods under specific climatic conditions, avoiding rapid skin formation on product surface.
application: Prolonging open time of R-Ston products under specific climatic conditions

name: Super PU Primer
description: Adhesion promoter for difficult polyolefin plastics and other surfaces (polyethylene, polypropylene, ABS, PET/PBT, glass, metal, painted metal). Recommended before application of waterproofing membranes and coatings.
application: Adhesion promoter before waterproofing membranes on polyolefin plastics and other difficult surfaces

name: Super-Accelerator PU
description: Considerably accelerates curing of IBTMAX. Stronger effect than PUR Additive. Allow additive to act 5–10 minutes after addition and mixing.
application: Considerable acceleration of IBTMAX curing. Dose: 1.5 kg per 25 kg IBTMAX.

name: Thickening Additive (Powder)
description: Powder thickening additive. Especially suitable for BT-Soft, BT-Floor and IBTMAX Aqua 2K on vertical or steep slopes. For TECNOCEM: use 1–2% by weight.
application: Thickening BT-Soft, BT-Floor, IBTMAX Aqua 2K for vertical/steep slope application

name: Thixotropy Additive (Liquid)
description: Liquid additive to increase thixotropy (anti-sagging) of polyurethane products.
application: Making IBTMAX and PU products more thixotropic for vertical or steep slope application

name: BT-Crete SL
description: Cementitious PU system. Thermal shock resistance and chemical resistance. Three liquid components (A+B+pigment) plus one mineral filler. Supplied non-pigmented, available in various colours.
application: Food industry, food processing & kitchens, pharmaceutical/chemical industry, vehicle maintenance, electroplating, heavy-use areas

name: BT-FloortTop 1K
description: 1K aliphatic PU resin. Lightly elastomeric, flexible and hard coating. Resistant to abrasion, UV, atmospheric agents and chemicals used in car park maintenance. Colorless version can be tinted in RAL colours with pigment pastes.
application: Protective finish for heavy traffic flooring: car parks, tanks, epoxy/cement floors (humidity <4%)

name: CBTDUR Eco
description: Water-soluble 2K aliphatic PU resin. Brilliant finish. High abrasion and chemical resistance. Excellent surface protection for floors subject to intense wear. Non-yellowing. Indoor/outdoor and public areas.
application: Garage flooring, heavy-traffic parking, microcement, artistic pavements, epoxy/PU/cement floors
consumption_text: Max. 200–300 g/m² per coat, min. 2–3 coats

name: CBTDUR Eco Matt
description: Water-soluble 2K aliphatic PU resin. Matt finish. High abrasion and chemical resistance. Non-yellowing. Indoor/outdoor and public areas.
application: Garage flooring, heavily trafficked parking, microcement, artistic flooring, cement/epoxy/PU floors
consumption_text: Max. 150–200 g/m² per coat, min. 2 coats

name: CBTDUR Eco Satin
description: Water-soluble 2K aliphatic PU resin. Satin finish. High abrasion and chemical resistance. Non-yellowing. Indoor/outdoor and public areas.
application: Garage flooring, heavily trafficked parking, microcement, artistic flooring, cement/epoxy/PU floors
consumption_text: Max. 150–200 g/m² per coat, min. 2 coats

name: Corundum Sand
description: Very hard aggregate, ideal for high-wear and high-friction environments. For industrial flooring and car parks. Available in three particle sizes.
application: Industrial flooring and car parks where high wear and friction resistance is required

name: Crushed Marble Aggregate (for IBT-Stone/Pavistone)
description: Crushed marble gravel, clean and dry, for use with IBT-Stone resin binders. Natural marble with possible natural shade variations — take bags successively from same pallet to ensure consistent colour. Available on request; check delivery time.
application: Resin-bound drainable pavement systems: paths, driveways, gardens, urban furniture. Use with IBT-Stone 1K HV, IBT-Stone 2K, IBT-Stone 2K UV.
consumption_text: 35 kg per m² for 2cm thick driveway system

name: Decorative Flakes — Berlingot Monochrome
description: Range of 55 original two-colour chip designs (3mm). Each chip can be used alone or mixed in white and black combinations. Acrylic resin with excellent UV resistance. Always seal with final topcoat.
application: Decorative finish in self-levelling or multilayer resin flooring systems
consumption_text: Broadcast into wet resin base coat; seal with topcoat

name: Decorative Flakes — Traditional Mixes
description: Acrylic resin flakes, mixed multi-colour blends. Excellent UV resistance. Standard 3mm size. Always seal with a final coat. For other sizes consult technical office.
application: Decorative finish in self-levelling or multilayer resin flooring systems
consumption_text: Broadcast into wet resin base coat; seal with topcoat

name: Decorative Flakes — Traditional Monocromatics
description: Acrylic resin flakes with excellent UV resistance. Available in ~350 colours and 6 granulometries (0.1mm, 1mm, 2mm, 3mm). Standard pack: 1 or 3mm. Always seal with a final coat of CBTDUR, CBTDUR Eco, IBT-Tanate, etc. Ideal in combination with IBT-Tanate 100 for fast decorative flooring.
application: Decorative finish in self-levelling or multilayer resin flooring systems
consumption_text: Broadcast into wet resin base coat; seal with topcoat
colours: ~350 colours available — single colour per batch

name: Epoxy Pigments
description: Pigmented paste for pigmenting 100% solid epoxy products (IBT Coat 100, IBT Coat 100 Clear). Standard colours listed. Other colours available: min. order 48 kg (12 × 4 kg).
application: Pigmenting 100% solid epoxy products: IBT Coat 100, IBT Coat 100 Clear

name: IBT Aquacoat
description: 2K water-based epoxy. Impermeable to water but permeable to water vapour (prevents blistering). Available in satin or glossy finish. Requires good ventilation before, during and after application.
application: Concrete floors and walls in industrial warehouses, factories, car parks, public buildings

name: IBT Coat 100
description: 100% solid epoxy paint for extra-thick coatings. Allows 1mm application in one single layer. Hard and resistant. Good weathering resistance. For industrial and commercial flooring under heavy loads.
application: Smooth (self-levelling) and rough (multi-layer/anti-skid) floors for industrial and commercial use

name: IBT Coat F
description: Pigmented epoxy coating for food-contact environments. Certified per EU Regulation No. 10/2011 for plastic materials in contact with food. Type 1 for simulants A, C, D2. Type 2 for vertical applications / simulant Type E (Tenax).
application: Food industry floors, food tanks, food processing facilities. General purpose for food industry multilayer to topcoat systems.

name: IBT Nivel / IBT Nivel Clear
description: 2K pigmented or transparent self-levelling epoxy coating for concrete protection. 2–3mm applied in one layer. High mechanical wear resistance. Smooth glossy finish, easy to clean. Can be used as primer in multilayer systems.
application: Warehouses, factories, car parks — all types of indoor areas
consumption_text: 3–4 kg/m² (resin + 0–0.3 quartz sand) with 5mm notched trowel for 2mm
colours: Colour 1 (9 RAL options), Colour 2 (6 RAL options), Clear

name: IBT-Floor
description: 100% solids self-levelling PU resin. Semi-rigid, solvent-free indoor coating. Good abrasion and scratch resistance. Requires aliphatic topcoat (e.g. CBTDUR Eco).
application: Homes, warehouses, industrial factories, garages, car parks, walkways, offices, bars/restaurants, hospitals, clinics, commercial zones

name: IBT-Polyurea High SL
description: 2K modified polyurea applied by mechanical projection. Slower and more self-levelling than other hot spray resins. Seamless elastic coating with smooth finish. Slow curing allows sand/aggregate broadcasting between layers for anti-skid finish.
application: Car parks, industrial floors

name: IBT-Soft
description: 100% solids self-levelling PU resin. Flexible resilient coating for indoor use. Solvent-free. Ideal for comfort flooring and asphalt refurbishment. Can be applied directly onto asphalt pavement.
application: Homes, halls, offices, hospitals, nursing homes, commercial areas, car park refurbishment

name: IBT-Stone 1K Arom
description: 1K aromatic PU binder for dark/brown aggregate. Drainable, flexible, crack-resistant seamless system. Yellows in UV — use with dark aggregates only (brown, beige, dark grey).
application: Paths, ramps, roads, bike lanes, footbridges, pedestrian areas, theme parks, parking zones, garden decoration
colours: N/A — aromatic; use with dark aggregates only

name: IBT-Stone 1K HV
description: Aliphatic 1K PU binder system. UV stable. Produces seamless, flexible, low-maintenance porous or semi-porous resin-bound floor. Can be applied with roller, brush or trowel.
application: Tree pits, paths, ramps, roads, bike lanes, footbridges, garden decoration, pedestrian areas, theme parks, parking zones, commercial areas, pool surrounds

name: IBT-Stone 2K
description: Aromatic 2K PU resin. Economical and fast curing. Porous or semi-porous finish. Yellows in UV — best with dark aggregates (brown, beige, dark grey).
application: Tree pits, paths, ramps, roads, bike lanes, footbridges, garden decoration, pedestrian areas, parking zones, commercial areas

name: IBT-Stone 2K UV
description: Aliphatic 2K PU resin. UV stable — can be used with any colour aggregate including light and clear stones. Seamless, flexible, crack-resistant floor. Hard and fast curing.
application: Same applications as IBT-Stone 1K HV — including light-coloured and clear aggregates

name: IBT-Stone Epoxy LY
description: Transparent low-yellowing 2K epoxy resin. Seamless finish. Best combined with dark aggregates where yellowing is not noticeable.
application: Tree pits, indoor flooring in schools/offices/malls, indoor Stone Carpet flooring

name: IBT-Stone Epoxy UV
description: Transparent UV-stable 2K epoxy resin. Can be used with all aggregate types including light and clear stones. High chemical resistance. Low viscosity.
application: Swimming pool surroundings, indoor/outdoor Stone Carpet flooring, garden decoration and tree pits

name: IBT-Tanate 100
description: Solvent-free aliphatic 2K polyaspartic. Slow reaction allows hand mixing and application. Much faster curing than 2K polyurethane. Non-yellowing. High thickness possible in one pass. Combines with coloured quartz sand and decorative flakes.
application: Fast curing at low temperatures. Good adhesion. High mechanical properties. Multilayer flooring in combination with coloured quartz/flakes.

name: IBT-Tanate 100 Flex / Flex S
description: Solvent-free flexible aliphatic 2K polyaspartic. Slow reaction for hand application. Flex S is the summer version (slower curing for high temperatures). For home garages, kitchens, bathrooms, public rooms, and as aliphatic topcoat on flexible systems.
application: Home garages, kitchens and bathrooms, public service rooms. Aliphatic topcoat on flexible systems.

name: IBT-Tanate 100 LV
description: 100% solids low-viscosity 2K polyaspartic. Gel time slow enough for manual application. Faster curing than standard 2K PU systems. Good adhesion. Colourless or pigmented. Thick layers in single application.
application: Flooring and multilayer combinations. Fast cure at low temperatures.

name: IBT-Tanate M
description: Solvent-based 2K polyaspartic for surface protection. Fast curing even at low temperatures. Good adhesion. High abrasion resistance. Applied by roller or airless. For industrial, marine and architectural solutions.
application: Industrial, marine, architectural. Top coat in flooring systems.
consumption_text: 2 layers of 200 g/m² each (200–500 microns total)

name: IBT-Tanate M Flex
description: 2K slow-reactivity polyaspartic. Unlike usual polyurea, can be mixed and manually applied. Fast curing profile once applied. Colourless or pigmented. For flexible comfort flooring systems.
application: Industrial, marine, architectural. Top coat in flexible comfort flooring systems.

name: PU Pigments (Solvent-Based)
description: Solvent-based pigment pastes for solvent-based PU products (CBTDUR, R-Ston Floor Top 1K). Standard colours vary from AED 152.70/kg (grey, black, iron oxide, tile red, beige, white) up to AED 246.99/kg (pale green). Other colours to order: min. order 12 × 4 kg, approx. 2 weeks delivery.
application: Pigmenting CBTDUR, R-Ston Floor Top 1K and other solvent-based PU products

name: R-Ston Floor D40 FR
description: Polyurea applied with hot spray machine. Completely solvent-free and free of mineral fillers. Seamless, cures in seconds. Fire classification Bfl-S1.
application: Coating for concrete/metallic floors (always with suitable primer). Protection of concrete structures in floors.
colours: Grey, Tile, Blue, Beige, Green, Oxide red, White

name: R-Ston Floor D50 FR
description: Fast-curing 2K polyurea for continuous pavement with fire resistance. Excellent mechanical properties: puncture resistance, crack bridging, tensile strength, elongation.
application: Indoor and outdoor car parks
colours: Grey, Tile red, Beige, Green, Iron oxide, White

name: Round Shaped Aggregate (for IBT-Stone Epoxy)
description: Round-shaped ornamental stone for use with IBT-Stone Epoxy LY and UV systems. Mix both granulometries for better aesthetic. Available in 5 colours. Exworks price — transport not included. Orders in multiples of bags; also available in big bag.
application: Decorative and draining pavements with IBT-Stone Epoxy LY and IBT-Stone Epoxy UV. Tree pits, garden decoration, small areas.
colours: Coralite red, Rose Valence, Cream Ivory, Light grey, Dark grey

name: Selected Quartz (Natural, F grades)
description: Natural quartz sand in various grades. F 0-03 is the finest grade. F 01-03 to F 06-1.2 are standard sizes at the same price. For use in resin flooring systems. Available on request; check delivery time.
application: Resin flooring systems: anti-skid surfaces, self-levelling primers, IBT-Tanate multilayer systems
colours: Natural (various shades — buy by full pallets to avoid shade variation)

name: Selected Quartz (Pigmented & Mixed)
description: Pigmented (FC) and mixed pigmented (FCM) quartz sands in various colours (see colour chart in PDF). For coloured resin flooring finishes. Available on request; check delivery time.
application: Coloured resin flooring finishes, multilayer flooring with IBT-Tanate systems

name: Spray Pigments
description: Liquid paste for pigmenting the A component of spray products (IBTmax 2K, IBTmax Polyurea H, Polyurea R-Ston, K-Tanate Spray, R-Ston Spray D50, IBTmax Polyurea H Flex). Other colours: min. order 48 kg (12 × 4 kg).
application: Pigmenting A component of hot spray polyurea/PU products

name: Water-Based Pigments
description: Water-based pigment pastes for polyurethane and epoxy water-based products. Standard colours listed. Other colours available: min. order 48 kg (12 × 4 kg), with delivery lead time.
application: Pigmenting water-based PU and epoxy products (IBTmax Aqua, IBT-Trans Eco, CBTDUR Eco, IBT Aquacoat)

name: IBT-Proline 100
description: 2K high-solids multifunctional epoxy. Surface tolerant — high adhesion even with poor surface preparation. Up to 300 microns per coat. Suitable with water jetting. For C3, C4, C5 and immersion environments. Volume solids: 88%.
application: Steel bridge structures, industrial steel structures, bins and hoppers, pipes, railway carriages, power transmission towers, tanks and steel storage vessels

name: IBT-Proline AC
description: 1K moisture-cure PU intermediate coating with micaceous iron oxide (MIO). Provides barrier properties and long protection. No dew point restrictions up to 99% RH. No restriction on max. recoating interval. Volume solids: 64%.
application: Intermediate coat in anticorrosion systems. -18°C to +55°C.

name: IBT-Proline CD
description: Highly cross-linked structural polyurea. Superior chemical and moisture resistance for liquid tanking involving chemicals or waste water. Very low permeability. Superior pipe protection in one-product, one-application format.
application: Liquid and waste chemical tank linings, pipe coatings, EPS structure protection (theming, furniture), fibreglass replacement for mould fabrication/structural backing, in-mold components

name: IBT-Proline CH
description: Pure polyurea membrane for chemical and moisture resistance in submersion applications. Very low permeability to Radon, Methane and CO₂. High impact, puncture and compression resistance. ISO 12944-6:2018 C5H certified system.
application: Chemical tank linings, secondary containment, pipe/culvert linings, below-ground pipe coating in soils with high moisture/chemicals, above-ground pipe coating with sand abrasion, re-instatement of leaking concrete tanks

name: IBT-Proline NE (Novolac)
description: Novolac epoxy, 78% volumetric solids. High chemical and mechanical anticorrosive resistance. Thermal resistance to 200°C (dry heat). Immersion resistance to 100°C. Recommended system: 2 × 150 micron layers (total 300 microns).
application: Inside tanks and pipes containing acids, gasoil. Continuous immersion with hydrocarbons and aggressive chemicals.

name: IBT-Proline Pro
description: 100% pure polyurea for industrial applications. Extremely hard wearing seamless protective lining. Excellent abrasion & impact resistance. Spray applied to any thickness in one application. Maintains properties from -40°C to +120°C. Can incorporate wear indicator zones.
application: Mining equipment, separator tanks, pipe/culvert linings, slurry and processing tanks, bulk material storage and handling, bins/hoppers/chutes, train carriage linings, conveyor belt repairs, trunk linings

name: IBT-Proline PU 1000
description: 1K aliphatic PU. Hard yet flexible protective coating. Colour fast, UV and chemical resistant. Protective topcoat over aromatic coating and waterproofing systems. Easy to apply.
application: Colour-fast UV/chemical topcoat for steel anticorrosion systems. Protective UV topcoat for cold/hot-applied waterproofing membranes. Outdoor wood protection. General outdoor use.

name: IBT-Proline PU AL Primer
description: 1K moisture-cure PU anticorrosion primer for non-ferrous and galvanized steel. Surface tolerant. Provides high adhesion, anticorrosion and long-lasting barrier properties. No dew point restrictions. Volume solids: 67%.
application: Non-ferrous metals, galvanized steel. C3–C5 & CX atmospheric corrosivity. -18°C to +55°C. Primer for waterproofing systems.

name: IBT-Proline PU Primer
description: Single-pack moisture-cure fast-drying PU anticorrosion primer with zinc and MIO. Cathodic (galvanic) and barrier long-term protection of steel. No dew point restrictions up to 99% RH. No restriction on max. recoating interval. ISO 12944-6:2018 C5H certified system. Volume solids: 67%.
application: Steel surface primer. C3–C5 & CX atmospheric corrosivity categories + immersion. Primer for waterproofing systems. Operates from -18°C to +55°C.

name: IBT-Proline Silver TC
description: Single-pack moisture-curing PU with aluminium pigment. Excellent UV stability and colour fastness. Improves anticorrosion and barrier properties. Can be applied as single-layer coating. Volume solids: 60%.
application: Topcoat and primer for steel, non-ferrous metals, stainless steel, and galvanised surfaces. C3–C5 & CX. -18°C to +55°C.
consumption_text: DFT 70 microns (8.57 m²/L) or DFT 100 microns (6 m²/L)

name: IBT-Proline Top
description: Hybrid polyurea for industrial applications. Extremely abrasion resistant (4mg loss CS17, 1000g, 1000rev). Impact resistant seamless protective lining. Very rapid return to service.
application: Bins and hoppers, dump truck bodies, ball mill linings, slurry/processing tanks, bulk material storage (grain, fertiliser, sand, gravel, coal, iron ore, gypsum), bulk material rail carriages, OEM parts subject to abrasion

name: Samples
description: The Krypton samples consignment held for Civil Defence submissions and client demonstrations. 22 lines, mostly 1 kg and 5 kg units, declared at EUR 90 for the whole lot. Not sellable stock and not allocated to any project. Held as one line because there is no packing list saying how much of each is actually in the box.

name: Baintchlore
description: Aliphatic 1K PU. Hard yet elastic and flexible. Excellent mechanical and chemical resistance including wastewater and saltwater. Resistant to continuous water immersion. Always supplied clear; can be pigmented on-site.
application: Protective finish for liquid-applied membranes in conduits and water containment (neutral, saline, slightly alkaline or acidic). Min. 2 crossed layers.
consumption_text: Approx. 200–500 g/m² in several crossed coats

name: Baintchlore 2K
description: 2K acrylic-PU hybrid, highly cross-linked with aliphatic isocyanate. Resistant to continuous immersion in chlorinated water. Hard shiny appearance when cured. Always supplied coloured. Min. 2 crossed layers.
application: Conduction and containment projects with salty or chlorinated water. Swimming pools.
consumption_text: Approx. 200–500 g/m² in min. 2 crossed coats

name: CBTDUR
description: 1K aliphatic PU. Hard, elastic, flexible coating. Excellent mechanical, chemical (wastewater, salty water), UV and outdoor resistance. Very good scratch and wear resistance. Suitable for continuous liquid containment immersion.
application: Protective topcoat for roofs, balconies, terraces, stadium stands with heavy pedestrian traffic; parking decks with light vehicular traffic. Liquid containment structures.

name: IBT Rimper
description: Elastic, weather-resistant acrylic rubber with excellent adhesion. EN-1504-2 anti-carbonation coating. Avoid applying on surfaces with stagnant water.
application: Sloped roofs & terraces (no standing water), chimney joints, cantilevers
consumption_text: 1.5–2.5 kg/m² in several layers with Geomax or Fiber 150 reinforcement
colours: White, Grey light/dark, Tile, Iron oxide

name: IBT-Top Fast 2K
description: 2K aliphatic polyaspartic topcoat. Quick curing. Good chemical, wear, UV and weather resistance. Elasticity and flexibility prevent cracking. Colourless or pigmented. Use pigmented version as aliphatic topcoat.
application: Protective aliphatic topcoat for waterproofing membranes where quick curing is required

name: IBT-Top Fast Flex / Fast Flex S
description: 2K aliphatic polyaspartic topcoat, very low solvent content (non-flammable, non-ADR). Hard and flexible elastomer. IBT-Top Fast Flex S is the slower-curing summer version (for higher temperatures).
application: Protective finish in waterproofing systems with PU or polyurea membranes. Terraces and balconies needing immediate return to service.
consumption_text: 1 or several layers of 0.3 kg/m² each

name: IBT-Trans
description: 1K aliphatic PU topcoat. Highly elastic. Excellent mechanical, UV and outdoor resistance. Available colorless or pigmented (reflective white/grey 7001, semi-gloss). Can be pigmented on-site with PU colour pastes.
application: Protective topcoat for liquid-applied waterproofing membranes on non-trafficable or light pedestrian traffic roofs. Finish for exterior decorative ponds and lakes.

name: IBT-Trans Eco
description: 2K waterborne aliphatic PU resin. Continuous elastic coat. Excellent mechanical, UV and outdoor resistance. Always supplied pigmented, semi-gloss. Resistant to medium-light pedestrian traffic. Increases ponding resistance of IBTmax Aqua / Acrimper.
application: Protective topcoat for pitched roofs. Complete solvent-free waterproofing solutions (cold/hot-applied solventless membranes).

name: IBTMAX
description: Self-leveling aromatic 1K PU waterproofing membrane. ETA 06/0263 (10yr W2, 25yr W3). CE Mark. BBA No. 11/4836. Anti-root. Bridges cracks. Adheres to cement, asphalt, metal, wood, ceramic, PVC, OSB. Apply with roller, brush or airless machine.
application: Roofs, terraces, balconies, channels, tanks, steps, ponds

name: IBTMAX 2K (Biobased)
description: Fast-curing biobased and eco-friendly 2K PU system. ETA 10/0296 25yr (W3). Certificate of resistance to root penetration (green roofs). Certificate of asbestos fibre encapsulation. Requires final aliphatic topcoat.
application: General waterproofing, concrete and metal structures, parking deck roofs, green roofs, asbestos encapsulation

name: IBTMAX 2K M
description: 2K solvent-free aromatic biobased PU. Up to 2 kg/m² in single layer, wet-on-wet system. Excellent radon barrier. EN-1504-2.
application: Roof waterproofing; radon barrier

name: IBTMAX A
description: Aliphatic moisture-activated PU. Fast curing — no CO₂ bubbles. Continuous elastomeric membrane, UV/outdoor resistant. High solar reflectance "cold roof" (SRI > 100) in white. Min. order 2,400 kg (1,200 kg per colour).
application: Roofs, terraces, stadium stands, canals, outdoor water containment structures
consumption_text: 0.5–1.0 kg/m² as second layer on cured IBTMAX base coat

name: IBTMAX Aqua
description: Water-based 1K hybrid aliphatic PU membrane for roofs. High thixotropy, easy application. Higher performance than standard waterborne membranes. EN-1504-2.
application: Roof waterproofing
consumption_text: 2 kg/m² in 2 layers with Geomax or Fiber 150 reinforcement
colours: White, Grey light/dark, Tile, Iron oxide

name: IBTMAX Aqua 2K
description: Solvent-free 2K PU. Certified per EU Drinking Water Directive 98/83/CE for continuous potable water containment. Totally stable when submerged. EN-1504-2.
application: Potable & wastewater tanks, reservoirs, gutters, fish farms

name: IBTMAX B 1K
description: 1K PU-bitumen resin, high thixotropy. Excellent mechanical properties. For difficult details and finishes with asphalt fabric membranes. High adhesion to bitumen finish. Root penetration resistant. EN-1504-2.
application: Waterproofing details and finishes; foundation waterproofing

name: IBTMAX Cold Polyurea
description: 2K self-leveling pure aromatic polyurea. Fast curing, highly elastic. Roller applied. ETE No. 17/0509 & BBA certified (incl. blue roof). Protect with aliphatic topcoat if exposed outdoors.
application: Flat roof waterproofing
colours: Red (iron oxide / tile), Dark grey (similar to RAL 7011)

name: IBTMAX Cold Polyurea ST
description: 2K semi-thixotropic pure aromatic polyurea. Fast curing, highly elastic. For pitched roof and details. ETE No. 17/0509 & BBA certified. Min. order 48 kits. Protect with aliphatic topcoat if exposed outdoors.
application: Pitched roof waterproofing and detail areas

name: IBTMAX Cold Polyurea Supreme
description: Totally solvent-free 2K polyurea. Provides mechanical resistance equivalent to hot-applied polyurea without requiring spray equipment. Highly elastic. CE EN-1504-2.
application: Roofs and liquid containment (interior/exterior)

name: IBTMAX EP
description: 2K epoxy resin. Very high thixotropy. 100% solids. Compatible with wet concrete (not standing water). High chemical resistance for continuous contact with wastewater. Approx. 1–2 kg/m².
application: Interior lining of manholes and buried structures without support movement

name: IBTMAX Evolution
description: Low odour, non-flammable modified aromatic hybrid PU. Stripped of residual hazardous isocyanate monomers. Thermosetting elastomeric membrane. For sensitive areas. Min. order 1,200 kg per colour.
application: Flat and sloping roofs; sensitive areas requiring low-odour, low-hazard resins

name: IBTMAX GC
description: Thixotropic 1K PU-bitumen resin. Applied in a single thick layer directly onto vertical or horizontal porous concrete — dry or wet (no standing water). No primer required. Root penetration resistant.
application: Foundation waterproofing

name: IBTMAX Polyurea H
description: Economic fast-curing hybrid polyurea. ETA 11/062 CE mark 10yr (W2). Certificate of resistance to root penetration. Requires final aliphatic protective coating.
application: Concrete waterproofing, general waterproofing projects, roofs, green roofs

name: IBTMAX Polyurea H Flex
description: Highly elastomeric fast-curing hybrid polyurea, >50% pure polyurea. CE Mark for bridge deck waterproofing. ETA Cert. EAD-030675-00-0107 No. 21/0740.
application: Bridge/viaduct decks, roofs, car park roofs, exterior concrete/metal structures, polyurethane insulation foam protection

name: IBTMAX Polyurea H Flex Alum
description: 2K polyurea with special aluminium pigments for improved UV stability and colour fastness. No topcoat required. Applied by 2-component spray equipment only.
application: Roof waterproofing (metallic appearance), surfaces where topcoat step is to be saved

name: IBTMAX Polyurea H Flex Bronze
description: 2K polyurea with special metallic pigments for improved UV stability and colour fastness. No protective aliphatic topcoat required. Applied by 2-component spray equipment. Always supplied already pigmented.
application: Roof waterproofing when metallic appearance is required or to save aliphatic topcoat application

name: IBTMAX Polyurea H Supreme
description: >600% elongation. Recovers completely after tensile forces — pure elastomer behaviour. Low and even viscosity for 1:1 spray. Use only flexible/elastomeric topcoats (e.g. IBT-Trans). CE EN-1504-2.
application: Most demanding applications on substrates exposed to extreme temperatures or large expansion/contraction movements

name: IBTMAX QC
description: Semi-thixotropic fast-catalysis PU for cold-weather (winter) application. Does not require stirring before use — mix slowly with roller. Anti-root. Bridges cracks.
application: Roofs, terraces, balconies, difficult geometric shapes

name: IBTMAX ST
description: Semi-thixotropic aromatic 1K PU membrane. Low mineral filler and solvent content. No specific mixing utensil required — mix slightly with roller before use.
application: Roofs, terraces, balconies, canals, reservoirs, stadium stands

name: Polyurea R-Ston
description: Fast curing 100% pure polyurea. ETA Cert. ETAG005 No. 16/0148 (25yr durability). BBA No. 18/5582. WRAS certified BS6920. CE EN-1504-2. DWD compliant for drinking water. Protective topcoat required if exposed to UV.
application: Concrete waterproofing, seamless liners for secondary containment, gutters, tanks, drinking water tanks, wastewater plants, roofing, terraces, car park decks, stadium bleachers

name: Polyurea R-Ston A
description: Pure aliphatic polyurea. Does not yellow. High colour/brightness retention exposed to sunlight. Eliminates aliphatic topcoat step (saves application step). CE EN-1504-2.
application: Recreational water containment: swimming pools, water parks, wave lakes, artificial beaches, aquariums, decorative fountains

name: Polyurea R-Ston Fast
description: Ultra-fast curing 100% pure polyurea. High chemical resistance. Fast curing allows very abrasive finish by overspraying a top layer. Ideal for vertical areas with aggressive chemicals.
application: Concrete waterproofing (mainly vertical), tanks containing aggressive chemicals

name: Polyurea R-Ston P
description: Last-generation pure polyurea system. Elastomeric membrane with greater strength than traditional pure polyurea formulations. Perfect viscosity compensation between A and B components.
application: Waterproofing of roofs and water retention structures

name: Polyurea R-Ston X5
description: Expandable polyurea forming an elastic and flexible membrane. Expands 3–5 times original volume. White colour. Asbestos encapsulation certificate. CE Mark.
application: Primer for irregular/dry surfaces (corrugated metal, fibrocement, bitumen felt, concrete). Low-cost waterproofing for non-trafficable roofs (requires aliphatic topcoat). Cushioning layer against impact on floors. Sound impact reduction.

name: R-Ston Fire E
description: Elastomeric pure polyurea membrane. Applied with 1:1 ratio machine. Does not contribute to spread of fire. Reaction to fire: Euroclass Bs2d0.
application: Stadium bleachers and structures requiring a coating with excellent fire resistance

name: R-Ston Spray D50
description: Very heavy cross-linked pure polyurea. Radon/methane/CO₂ gas barrier. Electrical current insulator. High temperature resistant. Very low permeability. High puncture, compression, and impact resistance. CE EN-1504-2.
application: Radon/gas barriers, building foundations, aggressive chemical tanks, wastewater/biogas plants, biogas digesters, leachate containment, electrical insulation of structures
